message:
The sovereign relation, held across time

The last three organ rows, and they only make sense together. Each guards a
failure that is invisible at the moment it happens and obvious in aggregate.

  Present Free Will Outranks the Model — the authority hierarchy as a frozen
  ordering, present conscious choice first, economic optimization last. Rank
  decides and evidence strength never promotes a rung, so a prediction with a
  hundred corroborating observations still loses to a person saying no today;
  the hierarchy is about what kind of thing something is, not how good an
  instance it happens to be. A commitment nobody currently endorses is refused
  as a commitment, since that is precisely how a past self acquires authority
  over a present one. "I know X is optimal, I choose Y" resolves to Y and is
  reported as sovereignty functioning, not as a conflict — a module returning
  CONFLICT there would be arguing.

  And the part the canon actually warns about: the failure is never a system
  announcing it has taken over, it is the accumulation of small defensible
  deferrals. deferralDrift counts them over a window, counting only decisions
  where present choice was on the table, and returns the observation to Mohamed
  rather than correcting for it — correcting would be the same failure from the
  other side.

  Free Will Amplification — the canon's claim is that UberBond increases the
  resolution of the chooser, not the number of choices. Those are different
  quantities and only one is easy to measure, which is why the easy one gets
  measured. Forty options understood no better than the four before them scores
  as NOISE_NOT_AMPLIFICATION. A cycle that never touched reality is
  CYCLE_UNGROUNDED, because letting it close would make the loop self-certifying
  — the system reasoning its way to the conclusion that its reasoning improved
  someone. Every resolution delta is required including the zeroes, since an
  unreported delta defaults to a claim either way.

  Temporal Civilization — Mohamed(t), against two opposite failures. Collapse:
  an observation from 22 quoted as a fact about the person now. It was true,
  it was well evidenced, and it is a claim about someone who no longer exists in
  that form; this is how personalisation becomes an identity prison, not by
  being wrong but by being right about a previous person and never noticing the
  tense. Severance: the overcorrection that treats each era as unrelated and
  loses the theme surfacing at 18, 27 and 41 — the one object an external memory
  spanning decades can hold and no human memory can.

  So persistence across eras is the only thing that earns the present tense,
  repeating an observation three times within one era does not, and a theme
  needs two eras before it is a thread rather than a moment. UNEXPLAINED stays a
  legitimate transformation kind: forcing a cause onto a change nobody
  understands is how a tidy story replaces a real one.

scripts/sovereign-relation-doctor.mjs runs the three together, which is where
the interaction shows. On the fixture present choice wins today against a
well-evidenced prediction and economic optimization — and the same run reports
that it has been deferring twice in the recent history. Both are true, and
reporting only the first is how the drift stays invisible.

Present Free Will Outranks the Model reaches its module through the
implementation manifest, since the name does not match a filename.

The nine that stayed SPEC_ONLY stayed there on purpose. Zero-Day Frontier Radar,

Four authority laws were likewise already enforced and undeclared: realityVeto

masquerade as a renewal; and classifySuiteRun separates a suite that skipped
itself from one that killed, which is "focused tests prove only focused seams"

The seven memory-index laws were enforced by nothing at all, so

Inflation: 438 opportunity IDs, 2,000 scored combinations, 12,114 text

INVENTORY or SYNTHETIC_SCALE count, and returns the number with its class

Amputation: a feature the current handoff omits reads as a feature that never

And the pair that is really one rule: current truth wins the present tense and
never deletes what it superseded. Precedence without preservation is how a
refactor eats a decade of context; preservation without precedence is how a
stale handoff outvotes the tree.

message:
Five reasoning organs, and two more ways absence was becoming a number

The Tier A thinking-quality gaps, each built around the failure that makes it
matter rather than the feature that makes it sound useful.

  Unknown-Unknown Mining — the frontier module already attaches questions to
  anomalies you flagged, which finds known unknowns. This looks for structure
  instead. An anomaly an existing model explains is excluded; five anomalies
  from one instrument is a fact about the instrument, not a hidden mechanism;
  an expected-but-absent thing counts only if the expectation was declared with
  a time and a reason beforehand, since a retrofitted expectation explains
  anything. And a domain no source covers produces silence that reads exactly
  like absence, so it is reported as a limit of the search — "we looked and
  found nothing" and "we could not have seen it" are different sentences.

  Assumption Escape / Incompleteness Awareness — a question whose answer flips
  when an assumption is dropped was decided before the reasoning started, and
  more reasoning inside a closed set produces confidence rather than
  information. An alternative foundation predicting identically everywhere is
  one foundation described twice. When no available observation separates them
  the answer is UNDECIDABLE_WITHIN_AVAILABLE_EVIDENCE and no plausibility
  ranking is emitted, because ranking there is the assumption set voting on its
  own replacement.

  N-of-1 Personal Science — a personal history is not a dataset, and the reason
  has nothing to do with sample size: the subject changed. A series crossing a
  declared regime change is split rather than pooled. Length does not promote a
  design, so two hundred observations of a before-and-after is a long
  before-and-after. A design that named no confounders has not looked for any,
  and blocks the causal claim rather than caveating it.

  Anti-Fragility Map — three retainers from one client is one income source.
  Redundancy counts independent failure modes, never instances, so a domain
  whose instances share a mode is a single point of failure however many it
  has. A fragility class is earned by an observed stress; ROBUST written on an
  unstressed system is a prediction wearing an observation's clothes, and any
  prediction is held beside the observation so it can be scored later.

  Freedom Gradient / Agency Geometry — effective freedom is a funnel of seven
  gates, not an option count. Coercion and non-endorsement disqualify outright
  rather than counting as two failures against five passes. The finding is
  which gate narrows. Measured twice, a rising nominal count with a falling
  effective count reads as AGENCY_DIVERGENCE, which neither number catches alone.

Two defects surfaced while writing them, both the same shape as the constraint
bug in the previous commit — absence quietly becoming a value.

Number(null) is 0 and Number('') is 0, so an unstated instrument error was
arriving as a claimed zero-error instrument: precision fabricated from a
missing field, in the module whose whole job is refusing that. The parse now
rejects null, undefined and empty string while a real zero stays a real zero,
and the guard is tested across all three plus the zero.

The reachability ratchet caught all five as shelfware, which is what it is for.
They are wired through two operator doctors rather than classified as dead:
scripts/reasoning-quality-doctor.mjs runs the three epistemic organs as one
pass, and the life doctor gains the freedom funnel and the fragility map. Both
are read-only, run on synthetic fixtures — private life data does not belong in
a repository — and carry zero external-effect ledgers.

Agency Geometry and Incompleteness Awareness reach their organs through the
implementation manifest, since neither name matches a filename, and the manifest
verifies the files rather than believing the declaration.

message:
Four life organs, and the promise that the matrix never overstates

Builds the four Personal Civilization organs that were SPEC_ONLY, and repairs
a truth defect the fourth one exposed.

The organs, each guarding the failure that makes it dangerous rather than the
feature that makes it sound useful:

  Life Possibility Engine — the branch inventory and what a decision does to
  it. Emits no net optionality figure, because a scalar there is the number
  that argues against marriage, mastery and every commitment whose point is
  closing branches on purpose. A closure is deliberate or unnecessary and a
  deliberate one must name what it bought. Breadth counts dimensions, not
  branches: forty futures that are all careers is one dimension with good
  imagination.

  Life Compression Engine — principles that survive being attacked. A
  principle nobody tried to break is UNFALSIFIED_NOT_PROVEN, never compressed;
  a decisive counterexample breaks it however many cases it explains; a
  "bounded exception" needs a boundary the principle declared beforehand, or
  it is how a refutation gets absorbed. Facts keep source refs so the
  compression is never the only copy.

  Gamechanger for Life — did the reachable geometry change, which does not
  follow from a market score. A signal naming no life dimension is novelty
  however high it scores economically; a claimed change states what would have
  to be true or nobody can check it; only personal testing settles a question
  about personal reach. Urgency and importance stay two facts, never one
  priority.

  GENESIS for Life — possibility without a vote. Twelve continuations of one
  identity is reported as CAGE_NOT_GENESIS rather than as breadth. No ranked
  list of lives is emitted, because that is a recommendation whatever the
  header says. Identity distance is recorded and is explicitly not quality.

A test found a real defect while writing them: a 40-character cap was silently
discarding REQUIRES_ANOTHER_PERSONS_CONSENT_NOT_GIVEN, which is 42 characters
long. Unknown hard constraints are now refused rather than dropped, so a typo
cannot become permission, and every constraint in the vocabulary is proven to
block.

The matrix repair is the larger finding. Regenerating coverage promoted
"Possibility" — one of the twelve terminal ontology domains — to
VERIFIED_CURRENT, because a module was now named life-possibility-engine.mjs.
It was not new: 26 structural rows and 3 alias rows already sat above their
classification on main, "Action" off browser-action-contract.mjs and
"Knowledge" off life-knowledge-graph.mjs among them, while the artifact
advertised matcherBias NEVER_OVERSTATES. Structural and alias classes now
outrank evidence in classifyState, exactly as BOUNDARY and EXTERNAL_GATE
already did, since no file can implement a category. Discovered evidence stays
on the row; only the state is corrected. NAMED_INITIATIVE and ECONOMIC_DONOR
are deliberately left outside the guard — a named programme genuinely can have
an implementation, and flattening those would buy consistency by deleting real
signal.

So the honest arithmetic runs the wrong way: four organs earned 13 rows and the
repair removed 18, and VERIFIED_CURRENT falls from 246 to 241 while SPEC_ONLY
falls from 138 to 126.

The organs are reachable through scripts/personal-civilization-doctor.mjs,
which runs the whole loop on a synthetic fixture — private life data does not
belong in a repository — and is read-only with a zero external-effect ledger.
